_comment: Config for weekly_report.py. managers: Sleeper user_id -> the short name used in the report, plus every label that name appears under in the Google Form. poll_sources: Google Form response sheets ('sheet', must be link-viewable) or the Apps Script ballot ('secret' names the key in secrets.local.json holding its private export URL; rows carry their own week). 'week' pins a whole sheet to one report week; 'from_week' skips a source for earlier weeks; otherwise ballots are bucketed by timestamp. Any data/polls/week_N.csv is also picked up automatically for week N.
tagline: Always written by A Bozo, never written by AI

poll_sources.note: BKN FFB Power Poll (Apps Script ballot)
